why_ai: Goods still have to be sourced, stocked and shipped and the item bet stays a merchant's judgement, but the middleman role is squeezed by direct import, brands selling direct and marketplaces, and the paperwork automates fast.
why_clarity: Complete shipments, margins and claims are measurable on thousands of recurring orders, but the buy is made by feel and graded only after the season.
why_digital: Orders, EDI and portals are digital, but the product is physical goods moved through warehouses, sold partly through reps and shows.

why_ai: Dealers depend on boxed units held in nearby warehouses and on distributor relationships, which software does not replace, though positioning and claims automate.
why_clarity: Fill rate on dealer lines is measured daily on repeat orders, but stock positioning through model changeovers is done by feel.
why_digital: Dealer orders come through portals and EDI, while the value is physical stock delivered to dealers within a day or two.

why_ai: Line reviews still turn on supplier relationships and item judgement, but replenishment, compliance and analysis around them are automating.
why_clarity: Scorecards and claims define success precisely, but item selection and line review outcomes vary by buyer and season.
why_digital: EDI, portals and scorecards carry the relationship; the goods shipped to retailer distribution centres are physical.

why_ai: Forecasting the retailer's orders is a data problem that models handle well; holding and shipping the stock is what stays.
why_clarity: Ordered units ship or ship short on every purchase order, counted weekly against the retailer's orders.
why_digital: Orders and product-activity data arrive by EDI, while fulfilment is cartons and pallets to distribution centres.

why_ai: Picking one-shot seasonal items months ahead is a novel bet each year with slow feedback, which models assist but do not take over.
why_clarity: Markdown money is measurable after the season, but item picks are made by feel and graded months later.
why_digital: Samples and showrooms start the work and the goods are physical, though orders and claims run through EDI.

why_ai: Store owners buy from reps and markets they trust, in person, and that relationship survives AI even as ordering moves online.
why_clarity: Reorders are countable, but why a store reorders depends on the rep, the season and the owner's taste.
why_digital: Show floors, store visits and paper orders, with Faire and rep apps as the digital channel.

why_ai: Pricing a messy lot from a manifest and handling physical goods of unknown condition stays a buyer's judgement, though pricing models help.
why_clarity: Realised margin per lot is measurable, but each lot is different and priced by experience.
why_digital: Manifests arrive digitally, but the goods are inspected, moved and resold physically.

why_ai: Tracking duty by authority, refunds and deadlines is document and rules work that software and agents absorb, with licensed brokers and counsel kept for filings and litigation.
why_clarity: Duty owed and refunded is exact per entry under written rules, recurring across hundreds of entries, with outcomes known in weeks.
why_digital: Entry summaries, ACE reports and notices in; ledgers and filings out, all electronic.

why_ai: Credit scoring on payment history automates readily, leaving judgement calls on loyal accounts and collection conversations.
why_clarity: Write-offs are measurable across thousands of near-identical accounts, but defaults show up months after the decision.
why_digital: Receivables, bureau data and orders are digital, with trade references and credit-group meetings by phone and in person.

why_ai: Matching claims to documents and drafting disputes and debit memos is rule-bound document work that funded agents already perform.
why_clarity: Each deduction is valid or not under written terms and either recovered or re-billed, thousands of times a year, with outcomes in weeks.
why_digital: Remittances, purchase orders, portals and agreements in; disputes and debit memos out, all electronic.

why_ai: Reading spec sheets into retailer templates is exactly the extraction work multimodal models now do.
why_clarity: Each submission is accepted or rejected against a written template, instantly, thousands of times.
why_digital: Documents and images in, portal submissions out, bought from vendors anywhere.

why_ai: Survey-based share tracking is data work that automates, protected mainly by the panel's history.
why_clarity: Quarterly share and price reports repeat on a fixed method, checked against retailer and maker data with some lag.
why_digital: Survey responses and scraped prices in; data feeds and reports out online.

why_ai: Scanning payment records for overpaid allowances and duplicates is pattern work that models absorb, with auditors kept for disputed claims.
why_clarity: Each claim is supported by the agreement and the payment or not, across millions of transactions, with outcomes when suppliers respond.
why_digital: Retailers' payment files and agreements in; claims out, all electronic.

why_ai: Forecasts and surveys automate, but members value the association's neutral convening role.
why_clarity: Forecasts and surveys recur on fixed calendars, but accuracy is judged a year later and methods vary.
why_digital: Member input and surveys in, reports and briefings out, with shows and meetings in person.

why_ai: Running online auctions automates fully, while the goods still need moving and grading by people.
why_clarity: Each lot sells or not at a recorded price, thousands of times a week.
why_digital: Auctions run online and buyers bid remotely; the pallets and truckloads are physical.

why_ai: Tariff determinations are statutory decisions by accountable officials, and demand for them does not fall with AI.
why_clarity: Each action follows statutory steps, but its merits are contested and judged in court years later.
why_digital: Dockets, notices and determinations are electronic, while the agency is a single national body.

why_ai: Retail Link analysis and replenishment reports automate; the agencies' local relationships with buyers are what stays.
why_clarity: Scorecards and sales are measurable on recurring accounts, but line review outcomes depend on the buyer.
why_digital: Portal data in and reports out, with in-person meetings near the retailer's headquarters.

why_ai: Shared payment data automates into bureau products, but members value the trusted room of peers.
why_clarity: Account reviews repeat each quarter, but whether a warning was right shows months later.
why_digital: Members' receivables data feeds discussion held at meetings, with minutes circulated afterwards.

why_ai: Order-capture software is the kind of product AI-native commerce tools absorb.
why_clarity: Orders are captured correctly or not, at volume, with immediate feedback.
why_digital: Entirely software sold and delivered online.

why_ai: Choosing and integrating acquisitions is novel, high-stakes judgement done by accountable executives.
why_clarity: Each deal is one-off and its success is known years later.
why_digital: Financial data in, but diligence, negotiation and integration happen in person.

why_ai: Monitoring listings automates fully, while legal enforcement against resellers needs attorneys.
why_clarity: Violations are checkable against written policies across thousands of listings, though outcomes depend on the seller's response.
why_digital: Crawled listings in, notices and takedowns out, all online.
